title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: and safeguards against clemency measures in corruption cases
part_context: Calls for the strategy to include streamlined measures assessing and targeting more preventive actions, given the focus of the current Directive on Combating Corruption on repressive measures; calls for the strategy to include regular, practical and adequately funded training programmes on anti-corruption for public administrations; calls for the strategy to include evidence-based mapping of the sectors, administrative levels and policy areas most affected by corruption in each Member State, so that preventive measures, resources, training and monitoring can be targeted where risks are higher; calls for both preventive actions and legislative proposals to strengthen the current EU anti-corruption legal framework, in particular on public procurement, grants and transparency, as well as on the definition of misappropriation and safeguards against clemency measures in corruption cases;
